author: ViceTechnicolour
body:
I have a very simple gamemode idea.

Basically, there's a deep hay map and you have to dig to find an iron block. PvP is enabled but players can't die, you can only knock them around with a knockback stick. Once you find the iron block, you click it and you win the match. For avicade.

replies.author: Myv
replies.body:
Great idea, but there is only one con to this.

Unless you can randomly generate the iron block to any coordinate within the haystack, people can note down the exact coordinates of the iron block and therefore this would give them an easy win.

Hope this helps.

replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
It doesn't sound like a bad idea, but I think that players should be able to die, and respawn. That is because if you only knock them back, they will come at you very quickly.
Also, if you are mining and are between several blocks, knockback won't do anything to you; it will just make your mining slower, and the game will take very long to finish.
